I pay close attention to relational schema design, query efficiency, and input validation. I also build responsive interfaces and connect them to backend services with modern JavaScript.

responsibilities: Designed a multi-tenant operations and inventory platform with Laravel, MySQL, and role-based access controls.
Modeled stock ledgers and order transitions with transactional updates, audit history, and scoped API access.
Built an asynchronous webhook dispatcher with Redis queues, signed payloads, retry handling, and delivery logs.
Connected backend workflows to responsive dashboards and validated forms using JavaScript.

projects.title: Multi-Tenant Operations & Inventory Platform
projects.shortDescription: A Laravel and MySQL platform for multi-tenant inventory, order transitions, and role-based staff access.
projects.problemStatement: Operations teams needed consistent stock records across warehouses, an audit trail for adjustments, and clear permission boundaries.
projects.solutionSummary: Organized the application into Laravel service boundaries, with transactional stock updates, scoped API tokens, and normalized MySQL tables.
technicalHighlights: Transactional stock updates protect inventory consistency during concurrent changes
Normalized MySQL schema with composite indexes for tenant, SKU, and warehouse lookups
Automated feature and unit tests cover tenant isolation and core workflows
Scoped Sanctum abilities enforce role-specific API access

projects.title: Queued Webhook & Notification Dispatcher
projects.shortDescription: A Laravel and Redis queue service that sends signed webhooks, retries failed deliveries, and records delivery history.
projects.problemStatement: Synchronous calls to partner APIs can slow user requests, and timeouts need a clear, recoverable delivery history.
projects.solutionSummary: Moved outbound requests to Redis-backed workers, signed webhook payloads, and stored each delivery attempt for inspection.
technicalHighlights: HMAC-SHA256 signatures let recipients verify webhook payloads
Exponential retry backoff handles temporary endpoint failures
Structured delivery logs record latency, status codes, and retry counts
Idempotent job keys help prevent duplicate notifications after worker restarts

projects.title: Personal Portfolio & Content Manager
projects.shortDescription: A responsive portfolio built with React and TypeScript, with an Express API and SQLite-backed admin tools for managing profile content, projects, skills, and experience.
projects.problemStatement: Portfolio content needs to stay easy to update while keeping public pages and project case studies consistent.
projects.solutionSummary: Built a React and TypeScript frontend, a server-side API, and a normalized SQLite store with an admin dashboard for editing portfolio records.
technicalHighlights: SQLite stores profile, project, experience, skill, education, and contact records
Admin tools support editing portfolio content through authenticated API routes
Project detail pages and resume downloads use the same live portfolio data
Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Express, and SQLite form the application stack
